title: Alleged Irish Crime Boss Charged After UAE Extradition
snippet: The alleged leader of a major Irish organized crime group was extradited from Dubai and charged with directing a criminal organization. Appearing without a lawyer, he told the court: “I think we know I won’t be getting bail.”
